title: Can this replica answer the read contract?
description: Place replicas, choose a request contract and read policy, change apply lag, then remove the primary region. The route, freshness, latency, recovery time, and data-loss window change together.

placements.label: Three replicas in Doha
placements.detail: Low write latency and zone-failure tolerance, but no copy survives a full Doha-region outage.
placements.recoveryNote: restore from backup or rebuild in another region before service resumes

placements.label: Async replica in Frankfurt
placements.detail: Nearby reads and regional recovery without adding Frankfurt RTT to each normal write.
placements.recoveryNote: promote the Frankfurt replica after fencing the old primary; writes inside the lag window may be missing

placements.label: Synchronous cross-region quorum
placements.detail: A committed write survives either region, but every write pays inter-region coordination latency.
placements.recoveryNote: form a safe quorum and promote Frankfurt after fencing; committed writes have a remote copy

policies.label: Primary-only reads
policies.detail: Read the write authority for current data, accepting cross-region latency and promotion gaps.

policies.label: Nearest-replica reads
policies.detail: Minimize network latency without proving that the replica has applied a required write.

policies.label: Session-token routing
policies.detail: Wait briefly for the replica to reach the client write position, then fall back to the primary.

requests.label: Profile immediately after update
requests.detail: The user must read their own completed write.

requests.label: Product catalog browse
requests.detail: A result up to five seconds old is acceptable.

requests.label: Fraud decision after account lock
requests.detail: The lock written in this session must be visible before authorizing payment.

incidents.label: Healthy replication
incidents.detail: The primary is available and replicas apply changes at the selected base lag.

incidents.label: Replica backlog
incidents.detail: A network or apply bottleneck multiplies replica lag by four while the primary remains healthy.

incidents.label: Primary region lost
incidents.detail: Doha is unavailable; only a previously placed Frankfurt replica can survive.

notice: Latencies and recovery times are illustrative. Production routing must use measured replica positions, health, fencing, quorum rules, and tested failover procedures; geographic replica count alone does not prove consistency or zero data loss.
